audit_status: Completed source audit, verified released-FA50 readout recomputation for both animals and pooled data, plus reliability/FA50/readout refits from released neural response arrays for Perle and pooled data

data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.responses: neural_responses, neural_responses_sh1, neural_responses_sh2: category -> neuron x condition x time
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.category_warning: vis/occ select different task trials; neither is merely a within-trial epoch
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.mask_values: finite means included; NaN means absent; binning can retain partly covered boundary bins
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.metadata: meta rows in PONG_BASIC_META_IDX order; py_meta_index identifies physical condition; neural_meta contains recording-session and unit fields
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.neuron_alignment: neural_idx_global[category][response_field] maps each response field separately into neural_meta; intersect/reorder by these IDs before comparing halves
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.raw_units: trial-mean count per 1ms bin, then mean of adjacent 50 bins; multiplying by 1000 gives Hz, not an integer spike count
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.bin_availability: the time-bin value becomes available at its right edge; 50ms bin must not be labelled available at its left edge
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.population: different recording sessions concatenated along neuron axis: condition-averaged pseudo-population, not simultaneous single-trial population
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.halves: within each unit's eligible trial set and physical condition, train_test_split(test_size=0.5, random_state=0) generates one fixed disjoint split; no independent resplits in released arrays
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.trial_counts: trial_meta and session-total ntr_vis/ntr_occ may be available; exact unit-condition stable trial counts and trial membership are not directly stored in aggregated fields
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.full_mean: odd trial counts can make full mean differ from equal-weight half means; imputation may create additional differences
upstream_processing: full-dataset condition-coverage selection removes neurons missing more than five conditions
missing whole-condition responses are filled with the neuron's mean across all conditions and times separately for each response field
unit stability uses a three-trial moving average of overall firing, an upstream selection not a test-time causal operation
paper and main builder specify independent 50ms bins without temporal smoothing; separate plotting utilities contain bilateral smoothing but main builder does not call it
reliability filtering in the official augmented fields uses both halves across all conditions, Pearson p < .01 and positive r
official FA factors are fitted using all conditions outside readout CV; each half's factors are fitted separately, so released FA half coordinates are not a shared reliability space
data_contract_from_code_not_yet_data_ver.upstream_boundary: a causal encoder cannot reverse global-mean imputation or all-data selection already present in the release; report processed-input causality separately from raw-spike causality

figures.3D: zero-lag all-condition pooled ball x/y readout
figures.3E: same fitted readout scored in visible and occluded within-trial masks

reproduction_plan.input: occ task category; reliable neural population represented by FA50
reproduction_plan.default: rerun readout on released author-fitted FA50 and compare its predictions to author saved zero-roll results
reproduction_plan.optional_refit: recompute reliability selection and FA50 from released full-mean responses, then repeat same readout protocol; no reimputation or smoothing
reproduction_plan.split: GroupShuffleSplit n_splits=100, train_size=0.5, random_state=0, all time points of a physical condition grouped
reproduction_plan.readout: single LinearRegression with intercept across all trial times; no temporal-history decoder; no additional scaling
reproduction_plan.row_filter: finite full-trial neural representation and all behavioral variables requested by official decode script; not just the two ball-position columns
reproduction_plan.paper_reference: Figure 3D pooled animals rounded r_x=0.97, r_y=0.83; single-animal outputs are not directly equal to pooled reference
reproduction_plan.claims_not_new: ball position, velocity, direction and behavioral-variable decodability are established analyses in original work
reproduction_plan.uncertainty: 100 overlapping train/test splits describe split sensitivity; they do not make 100 independent animals or trial-half replicates
implementation_caveats: official plotting helper uses standard deviation error bars while caption says SEM; report explicitly named SD across splits
helper computes mse_mu but omits it from an intermediate returned dictionary, leaving its stored epoch mse_mu NaN; recompute RMSE directly with explicit formula
helper's current Wilcoxon call tests occluded coefficients against zero, not visible-vs-occluded difference; this pilot will not inherit it as an epoch-equivalence test
original data_utils loader may overwrite pickles during augmentation; pilot uses read-only verified loader instead

adapter_validation.test: Three grouped splits, original Decoder_3Ddata vs pilot adapter using identical synthetic inputs and complete official target row filter

published_paper_discrepancy.status: Released artifact and recomputation agree to floating-point precision. Caption y=.83 does not round from released mean y=.8210 (.82). Reason unresolved; do not change filtering to force agreement.
published_paper_discrepancy.figure_code_check: code/utils/decoding_summary.py plot_decode_performance_xy labels mean/sd of per-split r; its plotted scatter instead contains split-averaged predictions. These estimands should not be swapped.

phase_result_boundary: Both within-trial phases show position decodability; the pilot has not tested epoch equivalence or reconstructed the paper permutation p-values. Original finite phase masks overlap at the transition bin; strict AE route excludes that boundary.

perle.fa_fit_scope: all conditions (official protocol; not strict held-out preprocessing)
perle.distinction: Fresh reliability filtering and FA fitting from published full-mean response arrays; follows original all-condition/transductive preprocessing, not pilot strict split

all.fa_fit_scope: all conditions (official protocol; not strict held-out preprocessing)
all.distinction: Fresh reliability filtering and FA fitting from published full-mean response arrays; follows original all-condition/transductive preprocessing, not pilot strict split
